concerns.text: T013 logs 'total end-to-end wall-clock time' including data loading and model initialization. T014a attempts to isolate inference time but is marked [ ] (unimplemented) and relies on T013's logic. Constitution Principle VI and FR-002 explicitly require 'isolating inference time from data loading and model initialization overhead'. The current task set fails to deliver the specific isolated metric required by the Constitution, effectively weakening the performance benchmarking constraint.

FR-006 and the Spec Edge Cases mandate: 'if normality is rejected (p < 0.05), the system MUST default to a Wilcoxon signed-rank test'. T027/T028 logic in the tasks (and implied in the plan) incorrectly treats p < 0.05 as 'normality accepted' or reverses the decision rule (defaulting to Wilcoxon when p > 0.05). This semantic inversion violates the statistical rigor required by FR-006, rendering the significance test invalid.

SC-006 requires 'A power analysis report is generated'. T030a implements the calculation but explicitly states it will 'ABORT subsequent statistical tests' if power is insufficient. The task list lacks a specific deliverable to generate the 'Power Analysis Report' artifact (e.g., `results/power_analysis_report.md`) that documents the finding (even if it is a failure). Aborting without generating the required report violates the 'generate' requirement of SC-006.

Spec Edge Cases mandate a fallback to 'nearest-neighbor interpolation of flow vectors'. T023 describes this fallback but does not define the algorithm for interpolating 2D vector fields (which is non-trivial compared to scalar values) or specify the handling of vector components. This ambiguity risks a silent implementation drift where the fallback is either impossible to implement as described or implemented incorrectly, violating the precision of the spec's edge case handling.

T033 requires verifying memory footprint < 6GB using a `--profile_memory` flag. The task description admits `generate.py` 'lacks' this flag. There is no separate implementation task in Phase 2 or 3 to add the `--profile_memory` flag to `generate.py`. This creates a dependency gap where the verification task cannot be executed, effectively weakening the Constitution VI constraint on memory footprint verification.
